lina_csm: Heads-up — GreenHarbor renewal ~45 days out. Noticed seat activity down ~62% last 30d. Procurement swapped primary contact last week (James). Any intel on a competitive PoC or procurement asks? Need triage before renewal.
ethan_se: Quick check — embedding requests dropped a lot but chat endpoints still have traffic. Looks like a subset of workflows moved internal. No obvious errors on our side.
maria_cs: Spoke to Ana (power user) yesterday — she said procurement asked for price bands + latency SLA. They haven’t started a formal PoC but mentioned OrchardAI in a convo.
david_ae: Sales flag — we demoed last month and they put OrchardAI on a shortlist. Procurement asked for TCO + perf comparatives. I can share our TCO slides. @lina_csm can we get James + Ana + product on a 30-min call next Tue?
lina_csm: Yes. I'll pull usage deltas and recommended playbook (discount pilot vs short-term Dedicated trial vs tighten batching). Will aim to have a one-pager by EOD Mon.
deploy-bot: Alert: billing/charge-check completed — no overdue invoices on GH account.
maria_cs: :thumbsup: Quick Q — did we have any recent infra incidents? They flagged latency with long contexts in the feedback.
ethan_se: No infra incidents. Latency spikes correlate with requests >4k tokens. Suggest recommending quantized medium model + adjusted batching and prefix caching.
david_ae: If cost pressure is the ask, propose a 3-month Dedicated pilot at 30% off with SLA. Sales wants finance pre-approval before offering.
zoe_finance: We can pre-approve pilot discounts up to 35% for strategic accounts. Need commitment terms (min throughput + renewal opt-in).
lina_csm: Great — I'll schedule Tue 10am PT and attach the summary by EOD Mon. Plan: 1) exec summary with metrics & delta, 2) recommended interventions (pilot + config tweaks + enablement), 3) ask list for procurement. Capture updates here.
